items.raw_excerpt: ¡Pueblo Nuevo tendrá nuevo Centro Comunitario! Inician obra con inversión de 10 mdp. 🎉 Beneficiará a vecinos con deportes, cultura y salud.

items.raw_excerpt: A strong maritime theme underpins the art of 81-year-old Tony Jones, whose workshop is teeming with boats and all things sailing.
items.summary_en: Tony Jones is an 81-year-old sculptor in Perth. His workshop is full of boats and sailing themes. He is famous for a work called 'Eliza', but his true love is sailing.

items.title_en: An 81-year-old artist's heart belongs to boats

items.raw_excerpt: After 13 years building a business around human hands, Wu is exploring AI and robotics to tackle manpower constraints and take Natureland into its next phase.
